page_title: MAL 1-0 ALA | Mallorca v Alaves 27/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' The referee shows the yellow card to Yusi (Alaves).
90+3' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
90+1' Alaves enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
87' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pablo Torre (Mallorca) replacing Manu Morlanes.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sergi Darder leaves the pitch and Javier Llabres (Mallorca) comes on.
86' The resulting corner from Denis Suarez (Alaves) is cleared.
84' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
82' Eduardo Coudet has decided to make a change. Denis Suarez (Alaves) replaces Carles Alena.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jonny Otto trots off the pitch and is replaced by Calebe (Alaves).

79' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) takes a good first touch from a cross and fires a powerful shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper, though, is ready and easily denies him.
79' Yusi (Alaves) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
77' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
76' None of the Mallorca players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
74' A pass from Samu Costa (Mallorca) is intercepted by Antonio Sivera and the move breaks down.
71' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. A free kick is awarded to Mallorca.
70' Samu Costa (Mallorca) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
69' Jagoba Arrasate is forced to make a change. Takuma Asano (Mallorca) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Mateo Joseph.
68' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Vedat Muriqi is replaced by Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca).
68' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Toni Martinez (Alaves) heads on.
66' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) unleashes a shot from distance but his effort is well blocked.
65' We are about to witness a substitution. Toni Martinez (Alaves) is replacing Pablo Ibanez.
65' Eduardo Coudet has decided to substitute Lucas Boye and he is replaced by Mariano Diaz (Alaves).
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yusi (Alaves) comes onto the pitch so that Victor Parada can be given a rest.
64' A pass by Jonny Otto (Alaves) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
63' Mallorca have been awarded a free kick. Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
62' A raking crossfield pass from Leo Roman (Mallorca) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
60' Mallorca take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
58' Substitution. Marc Domenech will be replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
58' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His glancing header goes over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
58' The ball goes behind for a corner. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

57' A great solo run by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the top left corner was easily caught by Leo Roman. The referee signals a corner kick to Alaves.
56' Carles Alena (Alaves) takes a short corner kick.
55' Carles Alena (Alaves) works the corner short.
55' The possession of the ball – 43:57.

51' Carles Alena (Alaves) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
50' Adrian Cordero blows the whistle, Jonny Otto (Alaves) is penalised for a foul. Mallorca will take a free kick.
47' Samu Costa (Mallorca) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
46' Lucas Boye (Alaves) tricks his way to edge of the area and unleashes a howitzer of a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Leo Roman earns his money with a fine reflex save.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Samu Costa (Mallorca) is penalised.
45+2' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45+1' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Antonio Sivera was alert and made a comfortable save.
44' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Mallorca are awarded a free kick.
43' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Victor Parada (Alaves). Adrian Cordero saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Mallorca.
41' Carles Alena (Alaves) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
37' 1 - 0 Goal! Takuma Asano (Mallorca) takes a short pass from Marc Domenech in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot inside the left post. 1:0.
35' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.

35' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal. Carlos Vicente (Alaves) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

34' The free kick finds Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) in space in the box, but he can't keep his header down and sends it just wide of the right post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
33' Victor Parada (Alaves) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
32' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
31' A cross from a corner kick by Mallorca is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
30' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Mallorca win a corner.
28' Carles Alena (Alaves) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
27' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) picked up a yellow card from referee.
27' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle after Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a free kick to Alaves in a dangerous position.
24' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
22' The game is interrupted. Jonny Otto (Alaves) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
22' Jonny Otto (Alaves) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Mallorca win a free kick.
19' A pass from Victor Parada (Alaves) is intercepted by Leo Roman and the move breaks down.

18' Jonny Otto (Alaves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Adrian Cordero saw the whole situation. Mallorca win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
17' Alaves take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
16' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
14' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Adrian Cordero signals. It's a free kick to Alaves, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
14' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
12' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Mallorca have a free kick.
9' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) is penalised for holding. Adrian Cordero signals a set piece. It's a free kick to Mallorca, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
6' Rough tackle by Jonny Otto (Alaves). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Mallorca will take a free kick near the side line.
5' Alaves are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
3' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) jumps into a tackle and Adrian Cordero signals a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Mallorca.

2' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
1' The first half has just begun.
Alaves will kick-off.
Adrian Cordero was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
